## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| timestamp_col | `timestamp_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Timestamp column. |
| gap_threshold_seconds | `gap_threshold_seconds` | Number | `30` |   | The run | Start a new segment at deltas greater than or equal to this value. |
| segment_col | `segment_col` | Text | `__segment_id` |   | The run | Output continuous-segment column. |
| delta_col | `delta_col` | Text | `__time_delta_seconds` |   | The run | Output seconds-since-previous-row column. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).
